# S4: macro-source ablation vs INDB (generated by scripts/fsn_s4_report.py)

Reference = INDB per-100 g values. Scored foods: 15 of 77 in the food set; 62 unscored (see S4_crosswalk.csv `status`). **No USDA/IFCT file with raw produce is available locally, so all raw/non-Indian foods (apple, banana, tomato, ...) are unscored; this table is Indian dishes only.** APE is undefined for reference < 1 g/100 g and those foods are dropped from MAPE only.

**Suspect reference rows** (INDB fat > 55 g/100 g, physically implausible for these dishes): bhatura (ASC143, fat 82.6), onionpakoda (ASC352, fat 71.8), samosa (ASC361, fat 59.2). Not corrected; both tables are shown.

**Circularity check:** the NutriX Indian rows (IND_FOOD_*) are not equal to INDB values (they are hand-entered round numbers), so DB-vs-INDB is an independent comparison.
